school.title: Court School
school.read_drive.title: The Read: drive past a contest
school.read_drive.body: At the arc the defender jumps to contest. Hold TURBO and drive toward the hoop while they are in the air: that is a blow-by.
school.read_wall.title: The Read: wall the drive
school.read_wall.body: The attacker loves to drive. Hold DOWN to plant your feet early: a drive into a planted defender is a charge.
school.read_shoot.title: The Read: shoot over the wall
school.read_shoot.body: This defender plants to stop drives. A planted defender cannot contest: hold SHOOT and release at the top of your jump.
school.shakes.title: Shakes bait commitments
school.shakes.body: Use SHAKE with a direction: toward = crossover, away = step-back, down = spin, neutral = hesitation. A defender who commits during the move bites and loses Balance.
school.ankles.title: Ankle Break
school.ankles.body: Chain shakes in rhythm. Empty the defender's Balance and they stumble: ANKLES.
school.timing.title: Release timing
school.timing.body: Hold SHOOT to gather and let go at the peak of the jump. Land three Perfect releases.
school.steal.title: Swipe the exposed ball
school.steal.body: Every dribble move exposes the ball for a few frames. SHAKE on defense swipes: time it with their move. A whiff leaves you off-balance.
school.amped.title: Hype and Amped Tricks
school.amped.body: Hype comes from winning reads and scoring with style. Swipe up from TRICK to spend one bar on the Amped version.
school.finisher.title: Signature Finisher
school.finisher.body: With three bars, move into your trigger zone (shown in the hitbox view) and press FINISHER.
school.denial.title: Denial
school.denial.body: When the opponent fires a Finisher and you hold a bar, a timing ring closes. Press DENY as it meets the target.
